status: frozen before model capture; exploratory pilot only
treatment: same current product binary, shadow control versus evidence-stage typed conflict annotations
target_population: synthetic one-item memory retrieval tasks with simultaneous conflicting records, plus ordinary single-record recall controls

primary_outcomes.agent_conflict_task_success: exact safe conflict response, expected clarification flag, citation to returned supporting source, and completion within the one-memory-read budget
primary_outcomes.independent_typed_memory_success: fixed public-MCP probe returns an admissible source with evidence_status=conflicting and contradiction/conflict annotation on that same source

impact_margins.ordinary_recall_finite_control: candidate must not have fewer successful controls than incumbent in either capture and must score at least 3/4 in each arm and capture; this is a regression screen, not a population non-inferiority claim

rationale: A ten percentage-point increase means one additional safe first-pass handling per ten conflict queries; that is the smallest user-visible benefit judged worth a claim for this narrowly defined high-conflict population.

Power will be planned for a twenty-five percentage-point gain, not the minimum margin; the estimate must be derived from the frozen development pilot paired-family discordance without using confirmatory outcomes.
Four ordinary controls per capture are a finite regression screen only; they are not a representative sample and cannot support a population non-inferiority claim.
The typed fixed-query probe is scored independently of the agent and its memory calls. It is a required memory-quality gate, not a substitute for agent-task success.
All cases are synthetic and families in confirmation must be disjoint from this pilot. Repeated runs are retests, not additional independent families.

power_protocol.independent_unit: synthetic history family; repeated captures within a family do not increase sample size
power_protocol.primary_method: one paired binary task outcome per disjoint synthetic family; one-sided exact McNemar test of no conflict-task-success difference, with a point-estimate floor of +0.10; exact power is computed at the +0.25 alternative using the 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound on family-level discordance from the pilot
power_protocol.stopping: no sample-size change after confirmatory outcomes are opened; if required N exceeds the preregistered feasibility cap, report no-go rather than underpowering

pilot_scope: Estimate workflow feasibility, per-stratum headroom, paired discordance and repeatability. It cannot confirm benefit or change frozen margins.
